T: Ten days to find Mum and get married.
D: A Darwin lawyer and her fiancé have ten days to find her missing mum before their wedding.
P: Serve the pavlova when the wedding finally happens on the Tiwi Islands.
S: the Mindil Beach sunset markets in Darwin
Coconut curry laksa broth with chicken, rice noodles, tofu puffs and bean sprouts, served in small cups.
Darwin mango and prawn rice paper rolls

Rice paper rolls packed with cooked prawns, ripe mango, vermicelli, mint and Vietnamese mint, with a sweet, sour and chilli nuoc cham for dunking. Soak 100g rice vermicelli in boiling water 5 minutes, drain and cool. Peel and halve 400g cooked prawns. Slice 2 mangoes and 1 cucumber into strips. Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds, lay flat, add prawns, mango, cucumber, noodles, mint and Vietnamese mint and roll tightly. Make 12. Mix 3 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp water, 1 chopped chilli and 1 garlic clove.
Road trip damper with golden syrup butter
Lauren and Ned's road trip through the Top End to find her mum

Golden crusted damper with a soft, fluffy middle, torn hot and loaded with whipped golden syrup butter and a pinch of sea salt. Heat the oven to 200C. Rub 60g cold butter into 450g self-raising flour with 1 tsp salt. Stir in 300ml milk to a soft dough, knead lightly and shape into a round on a floured tray. Cut a deep cross on top, dust with flour and bake 30 to 35 minutes until golden and hollow sounding. Beat 125g soft butter with 3 tbsp golden syrup and flaky salt. Tear the damper hot and spread thickly.
M: Barramundi fillets grilled skin down until crisp, with lime, chilli and a green mango salad.
Lemon myrtle roast lamb for the wedding
the wedding on the Tiwi Islands

Lamb leg studded with garlic and rubbed with lemon myrtle and pepperberry, roasted pink over potatoes and pumpkin, carved for the whole family with salsa verde. Heat the oven to 200C. Make 12 small cuts in a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves. Rub with 2 tbsp oil, 2 tsp ground lemon myrtle, 1 tsp ground pepperberry and salt. Roast on 1kg potatoes and 800g pumpkin in chunks for 1 hour 20 minutes for medium. Rest 20 minutes. Blitz parsley, mint, 1 tbsp capers, 1 anchovy, lemon juice and 100ml olive oil into salsa verde.
W: the wedding dessert in mango season
Crisp pavlova with a soft marshmallow middle, piled with whipped cream, sliced fresh mango and passionfruit pulp.
K: a steaming Darwin afternoon before the wedding

Ripe mango blended with white rum, fresh lime and plenty of ice until slushy, poured into chilled glasses with a lime wheel and chilli salt rim. Freeze the flesh of 3 ripe mangoes in chunks for at least 2 hours. Mix 1 tbsp salt with half a tsp chilli flakes, wet the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip. Blend the frozen mango with 160ml white rum, 80ml lime juice, 40ml sugar syrup and 2 cups ice until thick and slushy. Pour into the glasses and add a lime wheel. Leave out the rum and add 100ml coconut water for non-drinkers.

s.note: the Mindil Beach sunset markets in Darwin
s.how: Fry 3 tbsp laksa paste for 2 minutes, add 400ml coconut milk and 500ml water and simmer. Add 300g sliced chicken thighs and cook 8 minutes, then 100g tofu puffs. Divide 200g cooked rice noodles into 8 cups, ladle over the laksa and top with bean sprouts.

m.how: Score 4 barramundi fillets (about 180g each) and season. Grill skin down over high heat for 5 minutes, flip for 2. Toss 1 shredded green mango with mint, 1 sliced chilli, the juice of 2 limes and 1 tbsp fish sauce and pile on top.

w.note: the wedding dessert in mango season
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar. Shape a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 2 sliced mangoes and 3 passionfruit.
